The '''Invasion of the New Jedi Temple''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] took place in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[New Jedi Order]] withdrew from the war and refused to aid [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], the [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] ordered the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] to seize the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] and detain all Jedi located there.

==Attempted seizure==
After the Jedi [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|withdrew]] from the Galactic Alliance at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], the Jedi that remained on Coruscant prepared to evacuate the temple.

When the GAG stormed the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] Main Entrance, the Jedi repulsed the invaders and began to initiate evacuation and abandonment procedures. [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]] [[Seha Dorvald]], although a proven traitor and spy for Colonel Solo, destroyed two of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]' databanks after she transferred all data on to a holodisk. She then proceeded to escape with two other Knights through the under levels of the city-planet; leading her companions and the disk to safety.<ref name="Fury" />

The rest of the Order managed to escape off planet safely with few casualties. All [[StealthX]]s were removed from the hangars by their pilots along with anything else of value. The [[Temple employee|Temple Caretakers]] fled with the Jedi, leaving behind their lives and possessions in order to help the fleeing Knights.<ref name="Fury" />

The Order would rendezvous at the [[Jedi Outpost]] on the Sanctuary Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] where they would establish temporary [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] facilities until relocating to a confidential location on [[Shedu Maad]].<ref name="Fury" />
